name: Trades and home services
description: Roofing, plumbing, electrical, landscaping and similar. Built around the quote-to-job cycle, where speed of first response decides who wins the work.

customFields.label: Site address
customFields.helpText: Where the work happens, if different from the billing address.

customFields.label: Access notes
customFields.helpText: Gate codes, parking, dogs, best time to attend.

customFields.label: Quoted amount
customFields.helpText: In minor currency units, e.g. pence or paise.

taskTemplates.title: Confirm survey appointment the day before
Second chase if still no answer

sequences.name: Speed to lead
sequences.description: First response within minutes, then two follow-ups. Speed of first contact is the single strongest predictor of winning trade work.

steps.bodyTemplate: Hi {{contact.firstName}}, thanks for getting in touch. We have your enquiry and will call shortly to talk it through. Reply here any time.

Hi {{contact.firstName}},

Thanks for contacting us. We are putting together some options for your job and will be in touch shortly.

If it is easier to talk, just reply to this email and we will call you back.
Hi {{contact.firstName}}, just checking you got our message about your enquiry. Happy to answer any questions.

sequences.name: Quote follow-up
sequences.description: Runs after a quote is sent. Stops the moment the customer replies.

steps.bodyTemplate:
Hi {{contact.firstName}},

Just checking whether you had any questions about the quote we sent.

Happy to walk through it or adjust the scope if something is not quite right.
Hi {{contact.firstName}}, still happy to answer anything on the quote. Just reply here.

forms.name: Request a quote
forms.successMessage: Thanks — we have your details and will be in touch shortly.
forms.consentText: By submitting this form you agree that we may contact you by phone, SMS and email about your enquiry. You can ask us to stop at any time.

operatorNotes: The Speed to lead sequence sends an SMS immediately. Confirm your SMS sender registration is complete before activating it — in India this means DLT registration of both the sender ID and the template.
Quiet hours default to 20:00-08:00 in the contact's timezone. Adjust to match the hours you are willing to be replied to.
All sequences are created as drafts. Review the wording in your own voice before activating.
